book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Wɨɨwɨ ʉmʉkʉrʉ mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ?
Ribhaga riyo, abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu bhakamuuzaku, bhakamubhuurya,
“Nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ ʉmʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra abhandɨ mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ?” Yɨɨsu akabhɨrɨkɨra umwana wʉmwɨ, akamwimiirirya mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwabhʉ.
Akabhuga, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, arɨɨbhɨ mʉtakwichʉra na kʉbha ncha abhaana abhasuuhu, mʉtakusikɨra zee mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ.
Mmbe wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwiyicha na kʉbha nchu umwana umusuuhu wʉnʉ, wuyo newe ʉmʉkʉrʉ mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ.
Na wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araaginihyɨ umwana umusuuhu ncha wʉnʉ kuriina ryanɨ, aranginihya inyɨ.
Amaangirijʉ gu ukugirya abhaatʉ bhakore amabhɨ
“Nawe wʉnʉ araahabhyɨ wʉmwɨ gatɨ wa abhasuuhu bhanʉ bhakunyiisirirya akore ʉbhʉbhɨ, ɨnyaakʉ yaazɨ ɨrabha kʉrʉ bhʉkʉngʼu. Hakɨrɨku abhoherwe ʉrʉbhwɨ mwigʉti na korekerwa mubhwina bhwɨ ɨnyanza.
Horeera imwɨ bhɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ, kʉ kʉbha yo okokora amangʼana ganʉ gakugirya abhaatʉ bhakore ʉbhʉbhɨ! Ebhegemo bhereenderwa kʉbhaho, nawe horeera kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ araagiryɨ ibhitimotimo bhiyo!

Arɨɨbhɨ okobhoko kwazʉ hamwɨ ʉkʉgʉrʉ kwazʉ kʉragirya okore ʉbhʉbhɨ, ʉkʉtɨnɨ na kʉtaasha kore. Nɨ‑hakɨrɨku usikɨrɨ mʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano no obhorema, kʉkɨra kʉbha na amagʉrʉ gʉʉsi abhɨrɨ hamwɨ amabhoko gʉʉsi abhɨrɨ nawe ʉkarekerwa momorero gwa nyaari.

Naatu, arɨɨbhɨ iriisʉ ryazʉ rɨraagiryɨ okore ʉbhʉbhɨ, ryihɨ na korerekera kore! Nɨ‑hakɨrɨku usikɨrɨ mʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano ne esongo, kʉkɨra kʉbha na amɨɨsʉ gʉʉsi abhɨrɨ na korekerwa momorero gwa nyaari.”
Ekerenjo chɨ ɨngʼʉndu yɨnʉ yaabhurirɨ

Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mʉbhɨ mɨɨsʉ, mʉtarega wʉmwɨ mʉbhasuuhu bhanʉ! Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨrabhu, kʉ kʉbha bhamaraika bhaabhʉ mwisaarʉ, ribhaga ryʉsi bharɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Bhaabha waanɨ wa mwisaarʉ. [
Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ, izirɨ mʉʉsɨ korereke asabhʉrɨ abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhabhurirɨ.]
“Mʉrarorabhwɨ, arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ na zɨngʼʉndu igana rɨmwɨ, yɨmwɨ ɨkabhʉra, arakorabhwɨ? Ahaatiga hinga merongo kenda na kenda mʉkɨgʉrʉ, na kuja komohya yɨmwɨ yɨnʉ ibhurirɨ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, araayebhone, arazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu igʉrʉ wɨ ɨngʼʉndu yɨmwɨ yiyo, kʉkɨra zɨngʼʉndu zirya merongo kenda na kenda zɨnʉ zɨtaabhurirɨ.
“Ɨbhuɨbhu, Bhaabha waanyu wa mwisaarʉ, atakwenda nʉʉrʉ wʉmwɨ mʉbhasuuhu bhanʉ arimɨrɨ.
Ubhwɨndi bhwʉ ʉkʉhama wʉnʉ abhurirɨ
“Arɨɨbhɨ umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ akʉsaririiryɨ, nuujɨ omoreche imubheene bhabhɨrɨ. Ariikwigwɨ, ʉrabha ubhwɨnɨ umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ.
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ akɨɨrɨ kukwigwa, nuujɨ ogege ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ wʉmwɨ hamwɨ bhabhɨrɨ korereke ‘bhabheho abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhabhɨrɨ hamwɨ bhatatʉ bho okomenyeekererya amangʼana gayo.’
Na araangɨ kwigwa na bhayo, nuujɨ ʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ risengerero. Araatamɨ kwigwa na risengerero, mʉmʉbharɨrɨ ncha abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatɨɨzɨ Mungu hamwɨ umurihya wa rigʉʉti.
“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ ʉkʉbha waangirɨ kʉʉsɨ, garabha gaangirwɨ mwisaarʉ. Na ganʉ ʉraagiisiriryɨ kʉʉsɨ, garabha giisiririibhwɨ mwisaarʉ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra naatu, arɨɨbhɨ bhabhɨrɨ gatɨ waanyu bhariisiriranʼyɨ kʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ kʉsabha ringʼana obhorebhe, Bhaabha waanɨ wa mwisaarʉ arabhakorera ringʼana riyo.
Kʉ kʉbha arɨɨbhɨ bhareho nʉʉrʉ bhabhɨrɨ hamwɨ bhatatʉ bhanʉ bhiibhiringirɨ kuriina ryanɨ, na niinyɨ nɨrabha hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ.”
Ekerenjo chʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atakobheerera
Neho Peetero akaaza kwa Yɨɨsu, akamubhuurya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, arɨɨbhɨ umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichanɨ ansaririiryɨ, nereenderwa nemobheerere manga karɨnga? Manga muhungatɨ?”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Nɨkʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ, ɨtarɨ manga muhungatɨbhu, nawe omobheerere ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ muhungatɨ manga merongo muhungatɨ.
“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨrabhu, kʉ kʉbha ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ bhutuubhɨɨnɨ nʉ ʉmʉtɨmi wʉmwɨ wʉnʉ ɨɨndirɨ kokora ʉbhʉbhari na abhahocha bhɨ ɨsɨrɨkaarɨ yaazɨ.
Hanʉ ʉmʉtɨmi aatangirɨ kʉrʉʉha ɨbhɨtabhʉ, akareeterwa omohocha wʉmwɨ wʉnʉ aarɨ ani isiirɨ ya zimpirya nzaru bhʉkʉngʼu, zɨtaranta bhɨkwɨ ikumi.
Omohocha wuyo ataaturirɨ kʉrɨha isiirɨ yɨnʉ aarɨ nayo. Neho ʉmʉtɨmi akaswaja kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo aguribhwɨ ewe, mʉkaazɨ, abhaana bhaazɨ ne ebhegero bhyazɨ bhyʉsi, korereke arɨhɨ isiirɨ yaazɨ.
“Omohocha wuyo akahigama mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwʉ ʉmʉtɨmi, akamwisasaama, ‘Nɨrasabha unyiigumiriryɨ, nɨrarɨha isiirɨ yaanɨ yʉʉsi!’
Neho, ʉmʉtɨmi akamororera ɨbhɨgʉngi omohocha waazɨ, akamobheerera isiirɨ yaazɨ yʉʉsi, akamutiga ajɨ.
“Hanʉ omohocha wuyo aahurukirɨ igʉtʉ, akabhona omohocha ʉmʉkɨndichazɨ wʉnʉ aarɨ amʉhɨɨrɨ ekerengo kisuuhu bhʉkʉngʼu cha zidinaari igana rɨmwɨ.
Hayohayo, akamugwata mwimero, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Ndɨha isiirɨ yaanɨ!’
“Omohocha ʉmʉkɨndichazɨ akahigama mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwazɨ, akamwisasaama, ‘Nɨrasabha unyiigumiriryɨ, nɨrakʉrɨha isiirɨ yaazʉ yʉʉsi!’
Nawe akaanga, akaja komobhoha ʉmʉkɨndichazɨ mokebhoho, kuhika ribhaga rɨnʉ araarɨhɨ isiirɨ yaazɨ.
“Hanʉ abhahocha abhakɨndichazɨ bhaarʉʉzɨ ringʼana riyo, bhakanyahaarɨka mozekoro zaabhʉ. Bhakaja kʉmʉtɨmi waabhʉ na kʉmʉbhʉʉrɨra gʉʉsi ganʉ gakʉrirwɨ.
Neho ʉmʉtɨmi akabhɨrɨkɨra omohocha wʉnʉ aabhɨɨrɨɨrɨ isiirɨ yaazɨ, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Awɨ ne‑mohocha mʉbhɨ! Rora, hanʉ wansabhirɨ kʉbha nekobheerere isiirɨ yaazʉ, nɨkakobheerera yʉʉsi!
Awɨ ʉtamirwɨ komororera ɨbhɨgʉngi omohocha ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ, chɨmbu inyɨ nakʉrʉrɨɨrɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi?’
“Mmbe, ʉmʉtɨmi akiigatana bhʉkʉngʼu, akaswaja abhasirikarɨ bhaazɨ, bhamʉgwatɨ na kʉmʉtʉʉra mokebhoho, bhamʉnyaachɨmu, kuhika hanʉ araamʉrɨhɨ isiirɨ yʉʉsi.”
Akʉmara, Yɨɨsu akamara kwa kʉgamba, “Momenye kʉbha nʉʉrʉ Bhaabha waanɨ wa mwisaarʉ, arabhakorera na niimwɨ ɨbhuɨbhu, arɨɨbhɨ mʉraanga kobheerera ʉmʉkɨndichanyu kumyʉyʉ janyu jʉsi.”

footnotes.text: Muhungatɨ manga merongo muhungatɨ, enzobhooro yaku, umwabhɨrɨ ribhaga ryʉsi.
Ɨtaranta yɨmwɨ yaarɨ ɨrɨngʼɨɨnɨ na amarihi gʉ ʉkʉrɨha ʉmʉʉtʉ imyaka merongo ɨbhɨrɨ hamwɨ kʉkɨra.
Idinaari yɨmwɨ yaarɨ ɨrɨngʼɨɨnɨ na amarihi gu urusikʉ rʉmwɨ kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ.
